characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A sturdy linen tunic of deep brown color, reaching mid-thigh and slightly flared at the waist; a matching pair of woolen leggings in a darker shade tucked into worn leather calf‑high boots. Over the tunic she wears a plain white cotton apron tied snugly around her waist with a simple leather belt. Her hair is pulled back loosely to keep it out of her face while working
